programs.name: 2 Step Standard
programs.notes: Targets are $4,000 in phase 1 and $2,000 in phase 2.

news_trading: Restricted: allowed in challenges; on funded/instant accounts no opening/closing within 5 minutes before/after high-impact (red folder) news and FOMC, profits may be removed; Instant Standard bought after 13 Nov 2025 no news trading
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: EAs allowed for your own strategies on forex/CFD; HFT, tick scalping (trades under 2 minutes flagged) and arbitrage bots prohibited
copy_trading: Restricted: only between accounts you legally own; copying another trader prohibited; hedging across accounts prohibited
overnight_weekend_holding: Overnight and weekend holding allowed on forex/CFD accounts
restricted_countries_note: Forex help center lists Afghanistan, Albania, Algeria, Cuba, Iran, Jordan, Libya, Myanmar, North Korea, Philippines, Senegal, Syria, Vietnam; futures list is longer (incl. Iraq, Israel, Malaysia, Pakistan, Russia, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela, Yemen). https://help.blueguardian.com/en/articles/15618204-general-information-rules

affiliate_program.notes: Can apply to skip to Level 3; bonuses not for custom deals

recent_changes_2026.change: 1 Step Standard target cut from 10% to 9%; 2 Step Standard min trading days cut from 5 to 3 (accounts bought from 20 Aug)
Futures Express: from 2nd payout, new profit equal to 50% of previous payout required (accounts bought from 2 Sep)

pros: 2 Step Standard uses a static 8% max loss
Payouts processed within 24 business hours per help center
Instant funding option with on-demand payouts
Both forex/CFD and futures under one brand; overnight/weekend holding and own EAs allowed
cons: Trustpilot rating suspended for a guideline breach (fake reviews removed)
1 Step and Instant use trailing drawdown
Guardian Shield: 1-2% floating loss closes trades and first breach halves the split
3% processing fee on every payout; strict no-refund policy
News trading restricted on funded accounts
best_for: Forex/CFD traders who want a choice of instant, 1-step or static-drawdown 2-step accounts and fast payout processing, and can trade within floating-loss limits.
